title: Map the compiler
result: A language note and a phase map you can use when a later unit gets confusing.

read.label: Project plan
read.why: See the complete language and the seven-unit route.

read.label: LLVM Kaleidoscope introduction
read.why: See how a small language grows one compiler stage at a time.

steps.text: Replace every TODO in work/01-language.md. Define types, scope, precedence, returns, and errors.
Replace every TODO in work/01-pipeline.md. Name each stage's input, output, and one error.
Trace 2 + 3 * 4 from characters to result without looking at notes.

check: The two notes contain no TODO markers, and the Rust starter prints its command list.

title: Scan source text
summary: Turn characters into tokens with source positions.
result: sprout tokens examples/tokens.sp prints a stable token stream.

read.label: Logos guide
read.why: Token rules and spans for the recommended Rust lexer.

read.label: Flex manual
read.why: Compare a classic lexer generator with your Rust route.

read.label: C side lab
read.why: Build and inspect the Flex scanner.

steps.text: Draw the accepting states for identifiers, integers, =, and == in work/02-dfa.md.
Implement the tokens command and emit KIND lexeme lines from examples/tokens.sp.
Reject an invalid character with a source location on standard error.

check: The token fixture matches in order, and an invalid character is rejected.

title: Parse programs
summary: Choose recursive descent and Pratt, or LALRPOP, then build an AST.
result: sprout ast accepts valid programs and rejects broken syntax.

read.label: LLVM parser and AST tutorial
read.why: A compact recursive descent and precedence parser.

read.label: LALRPOP tutorial
read.why: Use this if you choose a generated LR parser.

read.label: C side lab
read.why: Build and inspect a Bison expression parser.

steps.text: Record your parser choice and its reason in work/03-parser.md.
Implement the ast command. Show that 2 + 3 * 4 groups multiplication first.
Reject examples/bad_syntax.sp with a useful location.

check: Valid source has a nonempty AST, and malformed source fails.

title: Check names and types
summary: Resolve declarations and reject programs that have no valid meaning.
result: sprout check accepts a valid program and rejects bad names and types.

steps.text: Give resolved variables stable IDs and write an example of shadowing in work/04-semantics.md.
Implement check for int, bool, calls, and return statements.
Give bad names and type errors a location and a specific message.

check: The valid fixture passes; undefined names and wrong return types fail.

title: Run with call frames
summary: Interpret the AST with scope and recursive function calls.
result: factorial returns 120 and the loop program returns 6.

read.label: Course plan, runtime environments
read.why: Relate frames and scopes to PCIT702 Unit 5.

steps.text: Draw two nested factorial call frames in work/05-frames.md.
Implement interpret with local slots and an explicit call stack.
Run factorial, loops, and shadowing examples and explain each variable lookup.

check: The AST interpreter returns the expected values for recursion and a loop.

title: Lower to three-address IR
summary: Give each source construct a small instruction sequence.
result: The IR printer and IR interpreter agree with the AST interpreter.

read.label: Course plan, intermediate code
read.why: Review quadruples, triples, and the chosen IR shape.

read.label: Cranelift IR builder
read.why: See the backend's later input model.

steps.text: Define one IR representation and render a short example as quadruples and triples in work/06-ir.md.
Implement ir for constants, branches, calls, and returns.
Implement ir-run and compare its result with interpret.

check: IR is visible, and the IR interpreter returns 120 and 6.

title: Optimize, then choose a backend
summary: Make an observable IR improvement. Native ARM64 execution is the extra finish.
result: Optimized IR keeps the same result. Cranelift can run it on the server.

read.label: Course plan, optimization
read.why: Choose the small passes before loop work.

steps.text: Draw the basic blocks and control-flow edges for examples/loop.sp in work/07-optimization.md.
Implement ir-opt. Show one changed instruction sequence with the same result.
If you want native output, implement run --native using Cranelift.

check: The core check compares optimized IR with plain IR. Run uv run python lab.py check native for the optional ARM64 path.
